native_sources.name: Roles & Capabilities
native_sources.notes: Identity/authorization substrate only; no chat participant or moderation engine.

native_sources.name: WordPress REST API
native_sources.notes: Bounded request transport substrate; not realtime/private-chat semantics.

native_sources.name: Heartbeat API
native_sources.notes: Ephemeral polling substrate; does not define presence/typing truth or delivery guarantees.

native_sources.name: Comments
native_sources.notes: Public/content discussion primitive and explicitly not canonical private-chat persistence.

native_sources.name: Media
native_sources.notes: Attachment/resource substrate; private access requires separate authorization.

native_sources.name: WP-Cron
native_sources.notes: Scheduling substrate delegated to the Cron/Job owner.

records.label: Conversation Identity / Type / Lifecycle / Linked Resource
records.notes: Private/group/room conversation types and identities are established market functionality.

records.label: Conversation Creation / Duplicate-Prevention Policy
records.notes: Conversation creation is parity; deterministic duplicate prevention remains server policy.

records.label: Active / Closed / Archived / Moderation Hold
records.notes: Conversation/room lifecycle and moderation states are market-evidenced; WPE normalizes deterministic lifecycle values.

records.label: Safe Text / Markdown / Link / Emoji Policy
records.notes: Rich text/link/emoji messaging is parity but rendering remains sanitized and bounded.

records.label: Mentions / Attachments / Length Policy
records.notes: Mentions/files are parity; attachments remain Media/File-owned and authorization-filtered.

records.label: Edit / Delete / Redaction Windows
records.notes: Message editing/deletion is market-evidenced while deterministic edit/delete/redaction windows remain WPE policy.

records.label: Idempotency / Schema Version / Concurrency / Pagination
records.notes: Market messaging proves pagination/state, but schema versioning/idempotency/concurrency guarantees remain explicit WPE contracts.

records.label: Presence / Typing Privacy Policy
records.notes: Presence/typing are market parity where transport supports them; privacy controls and degraded behavior remain explicit.

records.label: Polling / Realtime Transport Profile & Degraded State
records.notes: Provider evidence proves AJAX polling vs WebSocket/reconnect dependencies; capability/degraded state must be exposed honestly.

records.label: Notification / Mute / Digest References
records.notes: Messaging notifications/mute behavior is parity; Surface 19 owns canonical routing/digest semantics.

records.label: Reporting / Moderation / Blocking / Rate Limits
records.notes: Moderators, kick/mute/ban/reporting are market-evidenced; WPE adds rate-limit/audit guarantees.

records.label: Private Attachment Authorization
records.notes: Protected/proxied file sharing is market-evidenced; every access still re-checks conversation/resource authorization.

records.label: Authorized Search / Retention / Erasure / Diagnostics / Definition Portability
records.notes: Storage/portability/privacy features are market-evidenced while Search/Privacy/Import-Export owners remain canonical integrations.

records.label: Arbitrary HTML / Script in Message Bodies
records.notes: Rich messaging is not evidence to accept arbitrary HTML/script; safe renderer formats and bounded providers only.

coverage.notes: All Chat records are market classified. Conversation/message/read/presence/moderation/file/privacy capabilities are parity; transport is provider-profiled, schema reliability remains WPE hardening and raw HTML/script stays rejected.
